items.stem: What accounts most for the huge declines in tourism in France?

choices.text: Heavy floods.
Safety concerns.
Bad economy.
Workers' strikes.

items.stem: What do we learn from the report about tourism in France?

choices.text: It is competitive with its numerous tourist destinations.
choices.zh: 凭借众多旅游目的地，它具有竞争力。

choices.text: It provides many job opportunities for French people.
choices.zh: 它为法国人提供了许多就业机会。

choices.text: It is the biggest concern of the French government.
choices.zh: 它是法国政府最关注的问题。

choices.text: It plays an important role in the nation's economy.
choices.zh: 它在国家经济中发挥着重要作用。

items.stem: What was the small plane's mission to Antarctica?

choices.text: To carry out a scientific survey.
To establish a new research station.
To rescue two sick American workers.
choices.zh: 营救两名生病的美国工作人员。

choices.text: To deliver urgent medical supplies.

items.stem: What makes flying to Antarctica dangerous from February to October?

choices.text: The darkness and cold.
The heavy snow and fog.
The biting winds.
The ice all around.

items.stem: How did Rick Rahim remove his son's loose tooth?

choices.text: By tying it to a door handle.
By shaking it back and forth.
With a remote control craft.
With a full-sized helicopter.

items.stem: What does the news report say about Rick Rahim?

choices.text: He has lots of fans on Facebook.
choices.zh: 他在 Facebook 上有很多粉丝。

choices.text: He has rich experience in flying.
He often suffers from toothaches.
choices.zh: 他经常遭受牙痛的困扰。

choices.text: He has learned to pull teeth from a video.
choices.zh: 他从视频中学会了拔牙。

items.stem: What did Rick Rahim advise parents to do with their kids?

choices.text: Spend more time together.
Tell them adventure stories.
Do something fun and creative.
choices.zh: 做一些有趣且有创意的事情。

choices.text: Play with them in a safe place.
choices.zh: 在安全的地方和他们玩耍。

items.stem: Why is the man making the phone call?

choices.text: To confirm an urgent appointment.
To collect a package from the woman.
choices.zh: 从女士那里取一个包裹。

choices.text: To ask the woman to sign a document.
choices.zh: 请女士在一份文件上签字。

choices.text: To arrange the delivery of a package.

items.stem: Why can't the woman meet the man today?

choices.text: She is doing shopping.
She is visiting a friend.
She is not at home.
She is not feeling well.

items.stem: Why is the man unable to see the woman tomorrow?

choices.text: He will be off duty the whole day.
He will be working somewhere else.
He will have to have his car repaired.
He will be too busy to spare any time.

items.stem: What should the woman do to receive her purchase?

choices.text: Sign her name.
Confirm online.
Pay a small fee.
Show up in person.

items.stem: What is the woman going to do?

choices.text: Vacation in Italy.
Study abroad.
Throw a farewell party.
Go to a fashion show in Milan.

items.stem: How does the woman feel at the moment?

choices.text: Quite sleepy.
Very excited.
Rather depressed.
Nearly exhausted.

items.stem: Why can't the man meet the woman now?

choices.text: He has to attend a party.
He has to meet a friend.
He has to make a presentation.
He has to finish an assignment.

items.stem: What will the man possibly do on Saturday?

choices.text: Say goodbye to the woman at the airport.
choices.zh: 在机场向这位女士道别。

choices.text: Meet the woman at the Black Cat Cafe.
choices.zh: 在Black Cat Cafe与这位女士见面。

choices.text: Drive the woman to the airport.
choices.zh: 开车送这位女士去机场。

choices.text: Have lunch with the woman.

items.stem: What does the speaker say about Mount Etna?

choices.text: It has kept growing over the centuries.
choices.zh: 它在几个世纪以来一直在增长。

choices.text: Its top is hidden in clouds of volcanic smoke.
choices.zh: 它的顶部隐藏在火山烟雾云中。

choices.text: Its height changes with each volcanic eruption.
choices.zh: 它的高度随每次火山喷发而变化。

choices.text: It has a recorded history of 1500 years.

items.stem: What do we learn about the lower slopes of Mount Etna?

choices.text: They are now a tourist destination.
choices.zh: 它们现在是一个旅游目的地。

choices.text: They attract a lot of migrating birds.
choices.zh: 它们吸引了很多迁徙的鸟类。

choices.text: They provide shelter for the farmers.
choices.zh: 它们为农民提供庇护所。

choices.text: They make good fields for farming.
choices.zh: 它们是良好的耕作田地。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about big birds like golden eagles at Mount Etna?

choices.text: They nest on the volcano's slopes.
choices.zh: 它们在火山的山坡上筑巢。

choices.text: They feed on certain small mammals.
choices.zh: 它们以某些小型哺乳动物为食。

choices.text: They compete with each other for food.
They match large mammals in strength.
choices.zh: 它们在力量上与大型哺乳动物相当。

items.stem: What do we learn about the speaker?

choices.text: He is self-employed.
He is a career advisor.
He studies talent.
He owns a magazine.

items.stem: What is the speaker's advice to his audience?

choices.text: Doing what they like best.
Loving the work they do.
Making no excuses for failures.
Following their natural instinct.

items.stem: What does the speaker say about talent?

choices.text: It does not come to anything without hard work.
choices.zh: 没有努力工作就不会有任何成就。

choices.text: It may prove to be quite different from hard work.
choices.zh: 它可能被证明与努力工作截然不同。

choices.text: It is a natural gift only some special people can possess.
choices.zh: 它是只有某些特殊的人才能拥有的天赋。

choices.text: It does not come to you until something special happens.
choices.zh: 直到特殊的事情发生它才会降临到你身上。

items.stem: What does the speaker say about the dance salsa?

choices.text: It is a bit difficult to learn.
It was popular in New Zealand.
It is a traditional type of ballet.
choices.zh: 它是一种传统的芭蕾舞类型。

choices.text: It evolved in the mid-1970s.
choices.zh: 它在20世纪70年代中期发展起来。

items.stem: Why did the speaker's mother enroll her in a ballet course?

choices.text: She wanted her to be a ballet dancer.
choices.zh: 她想让她成为一名芭蕾舞演员。

choices.text: She used to be a ballet dancer herself.
choices.zh: 她自己曾经是一名芭蕾舞演员。

choices.text: She hated to see her idling about.
choices.zh: 她不想看到她无所事事。

choices.text: She was too busy to look after her.
choices.zh: 她太忙了没时间照看她。

items.stem: When did the speaker's dancing life come to a halt?

choices.text: After she started teaching English.
Before she left for New Zealand.
When she moved to New York city.
choices.zh: 当她搬到纽约市的时候。

choices.text: Once she began to live on her own.

items.stem: In what way has salsa dancing benefited the speaker?

choices.text: It has renewed her passion for life.
choices.zh: 它重新点燃了她对生活的热情。

choices.text: It has made her happy and energetic.
choices.zh: 它使她快乐而充满活力。

choices.text: It has helped her make new friends.
choices.zh: 它帮助她结交了新朋友。

choices.text: It has enabled her to start a new career.
choices.zh: 它使她能够开启新的职业生涯。
